headline: ShengShu Technology has released a first public preview of Vidu Q4, its next flagship model for video and audio.
score_reason: Pool score 5 kept: a product preview from one company; the performance and value claims are the company's.
importance_line: Independent creators, small studios and advertisers may get a more controllable AI video tool, but the honest doubt is that the performance and value claims come from ShengShu, and the final release may change.
summary: Unite.AI reports that ShengShu Technology, the maker of the Vidu video model, launched the Vidu Q4 Preview on 7 Oct 2026, starting at $0.014 per second, with up to 15 image references and three audio references to keep characters and voices consistent. The company says the preview gives up to five times as much output for the same spend when settings and billing are comparable, and that final pricing and features may vary by plan and region.
notes: Read in full from Unite.AI (6,426 chars). The Unite.AI byline names an AI-generated research agent reviewed by its editors; the facts follow the company's launch material.
